The distance identity is T(rho_s,rho_t)=a Hamming(s,t)/d. The greedy code gives the packing. Common-basis dephasing is EB and fixes every state; measuring the basis and copying its outcome broadcasts them exactly.

The star inequalities give mu_l>=u_l>=2lambda_l-1 even for negative lambda_l, equivalent to I-Psi<=2(I-Phi). A universal symmetric 1-to-2 d-level cloner gives equality and twirled separable-Choi overlap forces any EB bistochastic comparator constant c>=2.
